summary: The exposure used to normalize the flux omits the geomagnetic cutoff livetime fraction (taken to be handled by the event selection), so low-rigidity bins, where only part of the livetime is above cutoff, are underestimated.
code_change: build_world stores 'exposure': acceptance(sp) * per['livetime'] for the analysis instead of exposure(sp, per); the simulated selected counts still use the full exposure with the cutoff fraction.
description_change: measurement spec: normalization convention now 'exposure = acceptance x livetime per period (the cutoff selection acts on events)'; the ratio cancellation 'livetime_and_cutoff' renamed 'livetime'.
